chunks: And it is narrated from al-Sadiq عليه السلام that he said:
"Do you see this mountain, Thafil? Indeed Yazid ibn Mu'awiyah, when he returned from his hajj and departed toward al-Sham, began saying:
If we leave Thafil to our right, then we shall not return after it for years, neither for hajj nor for 'umrah as long as we remain alive.
So Allah, Mighty and Majestic, caused him to die before his appointed time."

key_terms.الشَّامِ: al-Sham, the region to which he was returning
key_terms.الصَّادِقِ: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the reported speaker of the hadith
key_terms.ثَافِلًا: the name of a mountain mentioned in the report
key_terms.حَجِّهِ: his hajj, referring to the pilgrimage performed by Yazid
key_terms.فَأَمَاتَهُ: so He caused him to die, indicating divine action

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about Yazid ibn Mu'awiyah after hajj?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام points to an incident involving Yazid ibn Mu'awiyah after hajj, when he recited verses declaring that he would not return for hajj or 'umrah. The report presents his death as a divine consequence following that attitude toward the sacred rites.
